messages:
carlos_customer: hey support — our mobile client just started hitting errors when calling the rerank endpoint. we tried to switch to an SSE-based streaming client to show progressive scores, and now requests are failing with 415 and sometimes 401. billing also spiked a little. can someone help?

sara_support: sorry you're seeing this, carlos. can you paste the exact request headers + minimal repro? 415 usually is Unsupported Media Type. did you set Content-Type to text/event-stream?

carlos_customer: yup here is the snippet from the client (we're using a third-party SSE lib):

```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-abc" \\n  -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" \\n  --data-binary $'data: {"query":"best feature flags","candidates":["A","B","C"]}\n\n'\n```

carlos_customer: response body was 415 with JSON: `{"error":"unsupported_content_type","message":"rerank endpoint does not accept streaming content"}`. also earlier we saw a 401 when our token rotated during retries.

sara_support: thanks. few things: (1) the rerank endpoint does not support SSE/streaming payloads — it expects a single JSON request per HTTP POST (Content-Type: application/json). (2) 401 on retry could be separate — maybe token rotation race. the 415 explains primary failure. i'll loop in eng.

james_eng: looking into logs now. reproduced locally by sending `Content-Type: text/event-stream` + chunked body. proxy returns: `upstream_error: unsupported content_type 'text/event-stream' for /v1/rerank` — that's coming from the router layer before request reaches rerank service. so not a model bug.

james_eng: reason: streaming endpoints are only our generation/chat endpoints (they implement SSE). rerank intentionally doesn't stream (it's a synchronous scoring call). client must batch full JSON payload.

carlos_customer: ok makes sense. but two follow-ups: (A) why did billing jump? we saw several requests charged while client was trying to stream and retrying. (B) we sometimes see weird scores (some >1) when using our old client code — any chance streaming affected scoring semantics?

billing_bot: we looked at the request history tied to sk-customer-abc for the last hour. there were 7 POST attempts, 4 returned 415, 2 returned 401, 1 succeeded. we issued a manual credit for the 6 failed attempts (request ids: rq_9a8b, rq_9a8c, rq_9a8d, rq_9a8e, rq_9a8f, rq_9a8g). you should see the adjustment on your bill within 24h. ticket: BL-7832.

james_eng: regarding scores — rerank returns raw scores depending on score_mode. if you're expecting probabilities, you need to normalize (softmax) or use the `score_normalization` flag in the client if available. streaming the payload wouldn't change model scoring; the router rejected the request before it reached the scoring service. can you paste the exact JSON you plan to send?

carlos_customer: here's the JSON we thought we were sending (but SSE wrapper changed it):

```json
{
  "query": "best feature flags",
  "candidates": ["A","B","C"],
  "score_mode": "dot"
}
```

james_eng: that looks fine. examples of correct curl: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-abc" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"query":"best feature flags","candidates":["A","B","C"],"score_mode":"dot"}'
```

sara_support: to confirm next steps: (1) switch Content-Type to application/json and send a single request per re-rank call; (2) avoid streaming wrappers for this endpoint; (3) handle token rotation carefully to avoid 401 on in-flight requests (rotate and retry logic). i've opened a support ticket with the credits mentioned.

lex_oncall: small ops note — we should improve the 415 error to say: "Rerank endpoint expects application/json; streaming content-types (text/event-stream) not supported." filing ENG-9921 to update the router error string + docs. @james_eng can you triage?

james_eng: yep i'll pick up ENG-9921. quick workaround for customers: client-side, replace SSE codepath with a plain POST and parse the single response. if you need progressive updates, run multiple smaller rerank calls or move to a generation endpoint that supports streaming.

carlos_customer: thanks — one last repro detail in case helpful: when our library sent chunked frames the proxy logged `chunked body received for non-streaming endpoint` then rejected. if you want to reproduce: send request with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and partial event payloads. that replicates our failure consistently.

james_eng: good repro, thanks. i'll also add a sanity check to the router to return a clearer hint and a link to docs.

sara_support: resolved for now? carlos, want me to keep this thread open until you confirm SDK fix?

carlos_customer: yes please keep open. switching client now, i'll post results in ~10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy completed: main -> prod at 1830056830 by deployer_jen (ENG-9921 created).

sara_support: thanks everyone. follow-ups: billing credited, ENG ticket created to improve error message and doc note added to the rerank API page clarifying no streaming. carlos, ping here if anything else.
